    // The interquartile-range multiple defining Tukey's inner fences. 1.5 is a
    // convention, not a derived quantity: Tukey's outer ("far out") fences use
    // 3 instead, so the choice of multiplier is what these fences encode.
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Interquartile_range#Outliers)
    TukeyFenceMultiplier(_: Number): Number
        => 1.5;
